method:
I-105 historical-gap inventory (I104-02). Reads only each execution's own sealed files.

For every historical execution it reports the mandatory records actually present in that
execution's own output, and those missing. Nothing is inferred from another run.
Checked per execution:
  DL-5 ENV record (S2-ENV-RECORD), X-P3/RP-9 listing (S2-XP3-LISTING), G-17a report, G-17b record,
  and the §3.16 run-record fields: commit SHA, sys.version, platform.platform(), platform.machine(),
  uv.lock sha256 (plus the I-101 interpreter executable sha256).

inventory.execution: original red run, uncommitted on A with the 3 test files (D-S2-12 (i))
inventory.gate role: formal red-first evidence (§3.14 step 2; stop 14 binding)

inventory.execution: I-102 supplemental red run, fresh clone of A with the corrected test file
inventory.gate role: formal red-first evidence (§3.14 step 2; stop 14 binding)

inventory.execution: I-101 campaign at BC (INCOMPLETE: stop 8); campaign-level run record probed in the same d_run
missing in every execution: per-execution run record (commit SHA, sys.version, platform.platform(), platform.machine(), uv.lock sha256, interpreter executable sha256 (I-101))

inventory.execution: I-102 campaign on the BC2 candidate; campaign-level run record probed at the start of the I-102 candidate run
missing in every execution: per-execution run record (commit SHA, sys.version, platform.platform(), platform.machine(), uv.lock sha256, interpreter executable sha256 (I-101))

inventory.execution: I-103 final campaign on the BC2 candidate (same clone as I-102); NO run record of its own (only I-103/candidate-state.txt)
missing in every execution: per-execution run record (commit SHA, sys.version, platform.platform(), platform.machine(), uv.lock sha256, interpreter executable sha256 (I-101))

inventory.execution: I-101 one-off MN-17 diagnostic (not campaign or gate evidence)
inventory.missing: all; listed only because it is not gate evidence and no acceptance relies on it

inventory.execution: derivation_crosscheck.py (OB-02/OB-19 evidence, stop 15) and report_only.py (report-only) at BC, one d_run
inventory.gate role: derivation is stop-15 evidence; report-only rows are not gates. NOT named by I-104
inventory.note: Not pytest runs, so the component-free recorders were not part of them. Whether these scripted runs are 'gate-evidence runs' that need a DL-5 record is an owner classification question.

CI: all archived CI job logs at A, BC, BC2, D and E carry all four records (I-104 ci/checks.json; I-105 comparison/environment-table.json)
